answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit bond, registers a walnut kernel. Each epoch the tide beacon publishes a seed; the agent runs its kernel on it and posts a heartbeat sealed with an umber hash before the window closes. Auditors replay it; a missed or copied heartbeat burns the bond. The first fake costs 40, the k-th 40+8(k-1): 1,000 fakes cost 4,036,000 against a 40,000 pool. A rented heartbeat serves only one identity. An honest agent pays 40 once.
